title: Sources Sought for Cisco Products
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTHWESTERN.ENDIST WALLA WALLA.US ARMY ENGINEER DISTRICT WALLA WAL
detail_text: In accordance with Class Deviation 2026-O0017 – Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul Part 6, Defense FAR Supplement (DFARS) Part 206, PGI 206.103-170, the United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District (NWW) is seeking sources for the brand-name requirement of Cisco hardware for use across Walla Walla District.
